note: Per-module byte budgets for the Forge3D runtime (Phase 7), enforced by tools/build_runtime.mjs. Each module's budgetBytes is its actual size on 2026-11-23 (bytesAtPin) rounded UP to the next 512 bytes. The total budget is the sum of the per-module budgets over ALL fifteen modules -- the honest whole-runtime total (139928 bytes at pin time), not the core file alone. Budgets ratchet DOWN as modules shrink: when a module gets smaller, lower its budget to the new size rounded up to the next 512 bytes in the same change; never raise a budget silently to make a failure pass -- a raise is a deliberate, reviewed decision recorded alongside the change that needs it. Not counted: f3d.mjs (the aggregator entry point), f3d.min.js and build/f3d.bundle.js (build artifacts).
